Overview

Waterloo is a city in IA with a population of 68,000. Cedar Valley city with the John Deere Tractor Museum and a strong manufacturing heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials.
